import view

def test_basic():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    # finish with same id should succeed
    rows1 = [1,2]
    ok = v.finish(id1, rows1)
    assert ok == True
    assert v.rows == rows1
    # copy rows returns copy
    copy = v.copy_accepted_rows()
    assert copy == rows1
    # begin again creates new id
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert id2 != id1
    # finish with old id should fail
    ok2 = v.finish(id1, [3,4])
    assert ok2 == False
    # finish with new id should succeed
    rows2 = [3,4]
    ok3 = v.finish(id2, rows2)
    assert ok3 == True
    # after new finish, old id no longer current
    ok4 = v.finish(id1, [5,6])
    assert ok4 == False
    # notes dict persists
    v.notes['job1'] = 'note1'
    # begin clears error
    v.error = 'old error'
    id3 = v.begin('q3')
    assert v.error is None
    # finish with duplicate id (same as current) after begin? should fail because current_id cleared after finish
    # test that notes preserved
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'

def test_loading():
    v = view.View()
    v.loading = True
    v.error = 'test error'
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    # begin should clear loading and error
    assert v.loading == False
    assert v.error is None
    # finish with correct id sets rows and returns True
    rows = [1]
    ok = v.finish(id1, rows)
    assert ok == True
    assert v.rows == rows
    # copy returns copy
    copy = v.copy_accepted_rows()
    assert copy == rows
    # after finish, _current_id is None, so another begin works
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert id2 != id1
    ok2 = v.finish(id2, [2])
    assert ok2 == True

def test_duplicate_id_finish():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    id2 = v.begin('q2')  # newer id
    # finish with id1 (older) should return False
    ok = v.finish(id1, [1])
    assert ok == False
    # finish with id2 (current) should succeed
    ok2 = v.finish(id2, [2])
    assert ok2 == True
    # finish with id1 again should fail
    ok3 = v.finish(id1, [1])
    assert ok3 == False

def test_seq_monotonic():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert id2 > id1
    id3 = v.begin('q3')
    assert id3 > id2

def test_finish_without_begin():
    # edge: finish called without begin? spec says begin must be called first
    # but we can test that finish with non-existent id returns False
    v = view.View()
    ok = v.finish(999, [])
    assert ok == False

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_basic()
    test_loading()
    test_duplicate_id_finish()
    test_seq_monotonic()
    test_finish_without_begin()
    print('All tests passed')
